# nginx — 2010 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 2 nginx CVEs of 2010 are in `data/cve/vendors/nginx/2010.jsonl`.

### CVE-2010-2263
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-06-14 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 13822: Nginx 0.7.65/0.8.39 (dev) - Source Disclosure / Download (remote/windows, 2010-06-11, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 13818: Nginx 0.8.36 - Source Disclosure / Denial of Service (remote/windows, 2010-06-11, verified=1)

nginx 0.8 before 0.8.40 and 0.7 before 0.7.66, when running on Windows, allows remote attackers to obtain source code or unparsed content of arbitrary files under the web document root by appending ::$DATA to the URI.

### CVE-2010-2266
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-06-14 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 13818: Nginx 0.8.36 - Source Disclosure / Denial of Service (remote/windows, 2010-06-11, verified=1)

nginx 0.8.36 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via certain encoded directory traversal sequences that trigger memory corruption, as demonstrated using the "%c0.%c0." sequence.
